### Changed
- **The dev channel reads gitsemver 3's tag shape: a branch's builds are `X.Y.Z-r<branch-hash>t<YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>h<sha7>`, selected with `^.*-r<branch-hash>t[0-9]{14}h[0-9a-f]{7}$`** (giantswarm/architect-orb 10.10.0). Both charts, the kagent line and the Substrate line publish dev builds in that shape since 2026-09-23 (`gitsemver branch-hash <branch>` prints the hash, `588f3d76` for the lines' branch `giantswarm`); a filter for the superseded `X.Y.Z-dev.<branch>.<date>.<time>.h<sha7>` shape matches no new build. The defaults carry no filter and the stable ranges no `-0`, so a release refuses a dev build of either shape (`tests/verify-kagent-wiring.py` asserts it for the current shape too); the BOM check accepts an exact pin of either shape, and `verify-labels` renders both charts at a current dev version as well. README "Dev channel", UPGRADE.md.
